summary:
Held 1 of today's 10 biggest US movers.

• 5 upside misses — DELL +22%, MU +19%, LITE +19%, BE +19%, HPE +18%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (CRWD -9%, IP -4%, TSN -4%, TPL -3%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: DELL (+21.71%) — Not confirmed. Dell's fiscal Q3 report was scheduled for 2026-11-24 with strong AI-server backlog expectations, so the +21.7% is probably an earnings/AI-server reaction. I found no post-results coverage. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: DELL is a ~$230B large-cap hardware/AI-infrastructure name that no strategy lists. If it was an earnings gap, an earnings gate or gap-size cap would also have blocked entry.

top_movers.catalyst: No verifiable catalyst found. Searches returned nothing for NVDA on 2026-11-24. A +32% one-day move in a mega-cap is implausible, so it is probably a data artifact (bad close, split or adjustment error).
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe. NVDA is a mega-cap semiconductor name that no strategy lists, and only news-reactive-agent-top-n traded it. A +32% print would also trip any gap or RSI sanity filter, so the bot probably skipped it as bad data.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a data-quality gate that flags any large-cap daily move above +20% for cross-checking against a second price source before it counts as a mover. Add NVDA to the momentum universe only if the move is confirmed real.
